name: Google Chrome

knownPaths.description: Your Chrome profile: history, bookmarks, saved logins, cookies, extensions, and per-site storage. This is not disposable. Moving it signs you out of everything and can lose local-only data.
knownPaths.inventoryDescription: A Google-owned folder inside Application Support. Google stores unrelated things side by side here — the Chrome profile, the Google Drive filesystem cache, and the auto-updater — so read the folder name before assuming this is browser data.

knownPaths.description: Chrome's own download and network caches. Regenerates as you browse.
Chrome HTTP storage and cookies. Session state, not disposable cache.
Saved window state, used to restore your windows after a restart.
